header.title: Submit Your Research
header.description: Submit your research paper to our conference and be part of the global exchange of innovative ideas. We welcome original contributions related to intelligent energy systems and sustainable computing solutions, offering an excellent platform to share your work with experts and professionals worldwide.

submission.title: Paper Submission
submission.description: We are excited to invite researchers, academicians, industry experts, and practitioners to submit their papers to SAGAR2027. This is an excellent opportunity to showcase your original research contributions related to Soft Computing Techniques in Renewable Energy Systems and Smart Grid Technologies to an international audience.
submission.stepsTitle: To submit your paper, please follow these simple steps:

steps.title: Prepare Your Manuscript
steps.description: Ensure your paper follows the submission guidelines outlined in the publisher format. Manuscripts should be at least 3500 words or 10 pages.

steps.title: Create an Account or Log In
steps.description: If you do not have an account on Microsoft CMT, please sign up. Existing users can simply log in to proceed.

steps.title: Submit Your Paper
steps.description: Once logged in, follow the prompts to upload your paper in PDF format and provide the necessary details for review.

publication.title: Publication & Awards
publication.description: All submitted papers will undergo a rigorous peer-review process based on quality, originality, technical contribution, and relevance to the conference theme. Submitted a proposal to publish the SAGAR 2027 proceedings with Springer Nature Group. (Subject to final approval.)

guidelines.title: 1. Manuscript Submission
guidelines.description: Authors are required to submit their manuscripts using Microsoft CMT by following the provided submission link.

guidelines.title: 2. Paper Requirements
guidelines.description: Each manuscript submitted should constitute outstanding and solid advancement in the conference scope and allied disciplines. The main content of the submission should be at least  6 pages.

guidelines.title: 3. Submission Format
guidelines.description: The submission of manuscripts should be done in PDF format only.

guidelines.title: 4. Review Process
guidelines.description: All submitted papers will undergo a rigorous review process. Acceptance decisions will be based on quality, originality, technical content, and relevance to the conference theme.

guidelines.title: 5. Plagiarism Policy
guidelines.description: Every paper submitted to SAGAR2027 will undergo plagiarism detection using anti-plagiarism software prior to review. Papers not meeting the plagiarism policy (less than 15% & no AI content) may be desk-rejected without further review.

guidelines.title: 6. Proceedings Publication
guidelines.description: Submitted a proposal to publish the SAGAR 2027 proceedings with Springer Nature Group. (Subject to final approval.).

guidelines.title: 7. Author Policy
guidelines.description: SAGAR2027 strictly prohibits authors from altering their details or the sequence of authors once a manuscript has been submitted.

footer.title: Manuscript Submission
footer.description: The Manuscript has to be uploaded online at the SAGAR 2027 Microsoft Research Paper submission portal.
